description: Presidential Secretariat - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2046/11 of 21.11.2017
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the amendment of a municipal boundary description for land allotment required for construction of flats for resettlement. The order modifies the geographical jurisdiction from "Dehiwela - Mount Lavinia" to "Moratuwa" Municipal Council Limits regarding land described in a previous notification. While it mentions the President and Minister, it does not focus on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on land administration and urban development project provisions.
